name: Giving Gifts
overview: Scripture teaches that giving gifts and offerings is an act that opens doors and brings blessings, as seen in Proverbs 18:16 where a man's gift grants him favor with influential people. God invites His people to bring tithes into His storehouse with the promise of abundant blessings in Malachi 3:10. Jesus instructs believers to give with humility and sincerity, avoiding public recognition (Matthew 6:1, 6:3), and highlights the generosity of our heavenly Father who gives good gifts to those who ask (Matthew 7:11). The principle of generous giving is further emphasized in Luke 6:38, assuring that giving will result in receiving in overflowing measure.
